argocd._comment: OPTIONAL. Akuity's Argo CD MCP server. Disabled by default — the plugin's commands and agents work fully with the argocd/kubectl CLIs. Enable only for deep interactive troubleshooting: remove the leading underscore from _disabled, set ARGOCD_BASE_URL and ARGOCD_API_TOKEN, then restart Claude Code. See README.md > Optional: Argo CD MCP.
